name: grove
title_zh: macOS 上直接读写日历与提醒事项的本地 MCP
tagline_zh: 不用开日历 App、不用碰 iCloud 网页，在任意 MCP 客户端里直接增删改查日程和提醒。
tagline_en: Skip Calendar.app and iCloud web. Grove talks to Apple's local databases via MCP, so you can query and edit.
desc_en: Use Grove to read or manage Apple Calendar events and Reminders on macOS through its local MCP tools.
why_zh: 它不绕道云端，直接调用 macOS 的 EventKit 本地接口，读写即时、权限清晰。
why_en: It goes straight to EventKit via local MCP tools — no cloud relay, no sync lag. Calendar and Reminders become scriptable.
limit_zh: 仅限 macOS，且需在系统设置里给宿主进程授予「日历」与「提醒事项」的完全访问权限；只覆盖 Apple 日历与提醒。
limit_en: macOS only; requires Full Access to Calendar & Reminders in System Settings for the host process. Covers only Apple Calendar and Reminders — no.
